title: Port to The Carpentries Incubator lesson format
context: The Carpentries Incubator is a major distribution and adoption channel for domain-specific training materials, with an established instructor community and lesson-quality review process. Porting the curriculum to the Carpentries Workbench format (Sandpaper + Pegboard toolchain) enables submission to the Incubator and adoption by Carpentries-trained instructors globally. The curriculum is already designed to be Carpentries-compatible (Carpentries-style pedagogy, formative assessment, live coding), making the port primarily a format conversion. This is a backlog item conditional on the Carpentries adoption path being chosen.
objective: Port all core curriculum modules to The Carpentries Workbench lesson format (Sandpaper/Pegboard), complete Carpentries lesson metadata, verify the lesson builds successfully with the Carpentries toolchain, and open a PR suitable for Carpentries Incubator submission.
acceptanceCriteria: All core modules ported to Carpentries Workbench format: Markdown source files restructured to Sandpaper conventions (episodes/, learners/, instructors/, profiles/).
Lesson builds successfully with the Carpentries Workbench toolchain (sandpaper::build_lesson() or equivalent); no build errors.
Carpentries lesson metadata completed: config.yaml with lesson title, description, instructor names, learner profiles, and required software.
All existing acceptance criteria (WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, i18n-readiness, CI green for exercises) maintained in the Carpentries format.
A PR opened against the Elyos Projects repo (and optionally a Carpentries Incubator submission PR) with the Carpentries-format lesson; CI green; code MIT licensed; DCO signed off.
Reviewed and signed off by Educator reviewer; Technical reviewer confirms CI green.
resources: PLAN.md (Dependencies — The Carpentries; Solution approach — Carpentries-compatible authoring)
All published core modules (pilot-006, versioning-008, provenance-009, analysis-010, sharing-014)
output: A PR containing all core curriculum modules in Carpentries Workbench format, with Carpentries lesson metadata, a working build, and CI green; Educator + Technical reviewer sign-offs; optionally a Carpentries Incubator submission PR.
